title: Safe condition.
officialText: Safety net systems, guardrail systems, and alternative systems authorized under Section 3308.8 shall be maintained in a safe condition and used in a manner that eliminates hazards to the public and property. Any hazardous conditions or defects discovered with such shall immediately be brought to the attention of the responsible permit holder under Section 3308.4.
